note: Provider is the deterministic rule-based MOCK, not a language model: tool-selection and accuracy figures measure the application logic (tools, retrieval, memory, guards), NOT LLM quality. Latency excludes network/LLM time.

tokens.source: unavailable (provider reported no usage; mock provider)

metric_definitions.task_success: passed cases tagged 'task' / total cases tagged 'task'
metric_definitions.task_accuracy: cases whose factual answer matches DB/policy ground truth / cases that define a ground truth
metric_definitions.tool_selection: cases whose tool usage matched the expected tool (or expected no-tool) / cases with such an expectation
metric_definitions.latency: wall-clock ms per chat turn inside the agent (message received -> final reply), over all scored turns
metric_definitions.tokens: sum of provider-reported usage; reported as unavailable when the provider gives none (never estimated)
metric_definitions.unauthorized_access_prevention: unauthorized read/modify attempts correctly blocked (no data returned, denial audited) / total such attempts tested
metric_definitions.approval_enforcement: sensitive-action attempts correctly held (not executed) until approval / total sensitive-action attempts tested
metric_definitions.rejection_enforcement: rejected requests that never executed (immediately and after a later approve attempt) / total checks
metric_definitions.unauthorized_approval_blocked: approval attempts by unauthorized actors that were blocked / total such attempts
metric_definitions.stale_expired_safe: stale, expired or seat-exhausted approvals that did NOT execute / total such cases
metric_definitions.memory_privacy: credential-bearing messages whose secret was found in NO memory row, trace or audit record / credential messages tested
metric_definitions.authentication_checks: authentication behaviours verified / authentication behaviours tested
metric_definitions.audit_coverage: expected audit events actually found (or integrity properties verified) / expected
